scope: Exact prior/current comparisons for the rewritten opening; these are scholarly comparisons, not independent priority certification.
common_infinite_run_convention: Full inverse BFGS; arbitrary SPD initialization; fixed 0<c1<c2<1; differentiable accepted iterates with nonzero gradients; positive Armijo–weak-Wolfe steps. This matches Guo–Lewis Definition2.1 for infinite sequences.

comparisons.prior_result_or_question: Probability-one nonbreakdown/nontermination, Clarke-stationary cluster points, R-linear all-trial values, and conditional spectral-subspace identification for locally Lipschitz semialgebraic bounded-sublevel objectives.
comparisons.current_answer: Deterministic convex sufficient conditions and deterministic failures for one exact search.
comparisons.strict_difference: Exceptional initial points and nonsemialgebraic accumulation constructions establish neither positive-probability failure nor a resolution of the complete challenge.
comparisons.newly_selected_label_review: New mixed/homogeneous/planar labels are allocated to the positive-author proof and correspondence pass; final assembled labels will be checked before release.

comparisons.strict_difference: No claim that every Guo–Lewis theorem assumed matrix convergence or that every objective in its framework satisfies our sufficient conditions.
